title: Agora 審議會議備忘錄讀取會議自身決策卷宗與引文（保留隱私過濾與門檻面板行為）
register_work_package: RC6 WP6.3 Agora deliberative meeting memo case-file row (linked to FE-DECISION-CASE-FILE-VIEWS-20261113 and MEETING-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261115)

incident_context.symptom: On Hosted Dev, GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions/{session_id}/memos returned case_file_view = {'status': 'unavailable', 'reason': 'no_case_file_recorded', 'case_file': null} for every deliberative meeting (persona_meeting, e.g. mtg-ce73f5966e7f23be, mtg-72ee4d6606ed5712, mtg-e585f6a827ede4d4, mtg-34ee6bcfe9cf8d22) even when GET /api/consult/meetings/{meeting_id} held a composed case_file, rounds, and rejected_positions.
incident_context.root_cause: create_committee_router.memos() called CommitteeOwnerClient.memos(session_id) (which already fetched GET /api/consult/meetings/{session_id} for deliberative meetings) and then unconditionally called CommitteeOwnerClient.case_file_view(session_id), which always queried GET /api/consult/requests/{session_id}/transcript and ran project_panel() looking for a panel_case_file_attached transcript event that only gate panels (persona_panel) emit.

owned_layer: Agora committee BFF read projection and Consultation owner client/router wiring (services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/{owner,client,router}.py)
not_changed: Consultation service meeting storage, case-file composition, and memo generation
Gate-panel (persona_panel) transcript case_file_view projection (project_panel) and memo publish flow
Frontend CaseFileViewPanel and CommitteePage (already bound in FE-AGORA-DELIBERATIVE-MEMO-CASE-FILE-20261121 / execute-plans #1054)
changes: services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/owner.py: add project_meeting_case_file() and attach case_file_view in project_meeting() from the meeting's persisted case_file, rounds, and rejected_positions via project_case_file(..., tenant_id=tenant_id); resolve round position citations into cited_item_ids / unresolved_item_ids on contributions and map rejected_positions into rejected_contributions; withhold persona_private and user_private items and count them in private_items_withheld; strip raw unfiltered case_file and rejected_positions from the projected meeting payload; return unavailable_case('no_case_file_recorded') when case_file is empty {} or absent

services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/client.py: reuse the already-fetched meeting_detail in CommitteeOwnerClient.memos() to attach its projected case_file_view on deliberative meeting memos without calling GET /api/consult/requests/{session_id}/transcript (and route mtg-* session_detail/memos/case_file_view directly to self.meeting(session_id)); preserve gate-panel transcript case_file_view and memo publish behavior

services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/router.py: preserve pre-attached deliberative memo case_file_view in GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions/{session_id}/memos while calling client.case_file_view(session_id) for gate-panel memos

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_meetings.py and services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_case_file_views.py: add focused regression tests covering deliberative meeting memo/detail/session case_file_view projection, citation resolution, rejected_positions mapping, persona_private/user_private filtering, tenant and foreign private-servant 404 boundaries, empty/absent case_file handling, gate-panel transcript invariance, and the internal HTTP call budget

runtime_budget.internal_http_calls_per_deliberative_mem: <= 1 GET /api/consult/meetings/{id} + 1 GET /api/consult/memos (eliminates GET /api/consult/requests/{id}/transcript and GET /api/consult/requests/{id} on deliberative meetings)

residual_findings.finding: Source-only BFF delivery; live Hosted Dev verification of positive case-file content on natural deliberative meeting memos (e.g. mtg-ce73f5966e7f23be, mtg-72ee4d6606ed5712, mtg-e585f6a827ede4d4, mtg-34ee6bcfe9cf8d22) and recorded no_case_file_recorded on historical W47 meetings without a persisted case_file (e.g. mtg-0f7fa4993625ca47) requires the merged BFF commit to be deployed to Hosted Dev.
